tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: World and Interface. The black of every cut-out (scenery, monsters, the wanderer), the letterbox, the title arch's card and the arch tiles' ground. The same black as the World code's INK.

tokens.name: plaque-face
tokens.usage: Interface. The dark face of every dialog plaque (pause, settings, game over, initials, high scores, the rotate notice), inside its brass edge.

tokens.name: hud-face
tokens.usage: Interface. The face of the HUD plaques in play (health and mana, the wisps counter): see-through enough to keep the place behind it.

tokens.name: tile-face
tokens.usage: Interface. The face of the HUD's square tiles (pause, full screen).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Interface. The plaque's 1.5px edge, the selected item's band, primary buttons, a switched-on toggle, the chosen segment, the slider, HUD icons and the diamond on every rule. 3:1 or more against every face it borders.

tokens.name: brass-dim
tokens.usage: Interface. Secondary buttons' and segment groups' border, the rule either side of the diamond, keycap borders, initials arrow buttons' border. 4.2:1 on plaque-face.

tokens.name: brass-deep
tokens.usage: Interface. Unselected initials slots' border and the dividers between segments. Decorative: 2.3:1 on plaque-face, under 3:1; the letter or the segment's label carries the meaning.

tokens.name: rule-dark
tokens.usage: Interface. The hairline under a header that sits beside its buttons (phone settings and high scores). Decorative.

tokens.name: rule-row
tokens.usage: Interface. The hairline between settings rows. Decorative.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Interface. IM Fell English headings, every number (wisps), the selected initial, the New best label, initials arrows and HUD tile icons. 14:1 on plaque-face.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Interface. Menu items, setting names, secondary button labels, initials, names in the high-score table. 16:1 on plaque-face.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Interface. Values (80%), the unit under a big number (WISPS), the line above the initials. 12:1 on plaque-face.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Interface. Setting descriptions, ranks, column heads, keyboard hints. 8.8:1 on plaque-face.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Interface. An initial not yet chosen (the slots after the selected one). 4.8:1 on plaque-face.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Interface. Text and icons on brass: the selected item, primary buttons, a toggle that is On, the chosen segment, the highlighted row. 7.6:1 on brass. Also the focus ring drawn inside a brass control.

tokens.name: wisp-label
tokens.usage: Interface. The small WISPS label above the HUD counter. 6.1:1 on hud-face even over the palest place (Mist).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Interface. The empty part of the health and mana bars.

tokens.name: track-line
tokens.usage: Interface. The 1px line round each bar's track, so a bar's full length shows when it is low.

tokens.name: health-top
tokens.usage: Interface. Health bar, top of its vertical blend to health-low.

tokens.name: health-low
tokens.usage: Interface. Health bar, bottom of the blend. The top (4.2:1) meets 3:1 on the track; this lower stop is 2.5:1, kept as approved: the bar's length reads from the brighter top and the track line.

tokens.name: mana-top
tokens.usage: Interface. Mana bar, top of its vertical blend to mana-low.

tokens.name: mana-low
tokens.usage: Interface. Mana bar, bottom of the blend. 4.8:1 on the track.

tokens.name: brass-wash

tokens.name: brass-tint

tokens.name: brass-glow

tokens.name: scrim

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: The game's name in the title arch, two lines, centred, title-letter with the title glows. 46px on a phone held sideways.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A dialog plaque's heading, centred, in heading gold: Paused, Settings, Game over, New best (High scores is 34px to fit its plaque).

styles.name: heading-phone
styles.usage: Plaque headings on a phone held sideways, and the rotate notice (line height 1.05 there, two lines).

styles.name: initial
styles.usage: One letter in an initials slot (46px on a phone).

styles.name: title-item
styles.usage: Title menu items in title-item; the selected one 700 in title-selected. 19px and 44px tall on a phone.

styles.name: menu
styles.usage: Plaque menu items (pause, game over); the selected one 700 on the brass band. 18px and 44px tall on a phone.

styles.name: setting
styles.usage: A setting's name. 17px on a phone.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary buttons (700, on-brass) and secondary buttons (400, text). 17px on a phone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Gloam Hallow is played with the phone held sideways.

styles.usage: Segment labels in the Picture choice; the chosen one 700 on brass. Also the On/Off toggle's label (17px).

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Flatter scenery, slower rain, no shaking.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Keyboard hints under a plaque, in text-3, with keycaps. 13px on the title arch, in title-hint. Computers only.

styles.name: label

styles.name: flag

styles.name: unit

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: The score on the game-over plaque: tabular figures, heading gold, a brass-glow behind it. 54px on a phone.

styles.name: counter

styles.name: best

styles.name: table-score

styles.name: counter-label

picture.note: Fixed numbers of the World picture and its drawing.

tokens.name: picture-height
tokens.usage: The World is drawn for a 540-line picture; its width follows the window (960 at 16:9, about 1170 on a phone held sideways), scaled to fill.

tokens.name: ground-line
tokens.usage: The path's base height in the picture (gY), waving a few lines up and down. Everyone stands on it.

tokens.name: puppet-steps
tokens.usage: Monsters' and bosses' poses change 8 times a second, like card puppets (Reduce motion: smooth and at half speed).

tokens.name: strip-repeat
tokens.usage: The play strip's pattern repeats every 1900 picture pixels in the mock-up; levels are laid out by the game in 4a.

tokens.name: night-tints
tokens.usage: Night: how far each backdrop layer, far to near, is mixed from ink towards night-air.

tokens.name: storm-tints
tokens.usage: Blood-red rain: layer tints, far to near.

tokens.name: dawn-tints
tokens.usage: Dawn: layer tints, far to near.

tokens.name: mist-tints
tokens.usage: Mist: layer tints, far to near.

tokens.name: night-lift
tokens.usage: Night: the camera's lift, in picture lines. The place is drawn as if the camera had risen this far, then slid back up so the path keeps its height: the sky and its light sit higher by the whole lift, and the clouds, mist, backdrop layers and flyers by the lift times (1 - their parallax), so the layers' feet spread apart and stay readable on a phone. The path, the rain, the fore layer and the vignette do not move. The camera's own rise adds on top.

tokens.name: storm-lift
tokens.usage: Blood-red rain: the camera's lift, as night-lift.

tokens.name: dawn-lift
tokens.usage: Dawn: the camera's lift, as night-lift.

tokens.name: mist-lift
tokens.usage: Mist: the camera's lift, as night-lift.

tokens.name: parallax
tokens.usage: How fast each layer slides with the camera: backdrop layers 1-4, the play strip, the fore layer. Reduce motion: 0.4 times these for layers 1-4, 1.08 for the fore layer.

tokens.name: camera-rise
tokens.usage: The speed test's rise of up to half a picture (a starting figure, PRD question 5); each layer rises by its parallax.
